name: identity-administration-access
executionConcern: operator authentication, session lifecycle, trusted identity context, roles/permissions, Administration approvals/audit and governed Identity persistence
objective: Close operator access and Administration at their sovereign owners with fail-closed permission/object scope, durable session semantics and governed migration history.
truthOwner: Identity owns actors, credentials, activation, roles/permissions and sessions; DSH owns only the approved Administration projection/workflow facts and delegates other sovereign mutations.
journeys: activation and dev session where authorized

tasks.objective: Close Identity authentication and session lifecycle
tasks.currentProblem: Visible login success can diverge from authoritative activation/session rotation/revocation or trusted-context enforcement if UI/BFF state is treated as truth.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace login/activate/dev-session/refresh/logout/session through Identity contracts/backend/database; enforce server-derived context, atomic refresh rotation, revocation and explicit unavailable/rate-limit/invalid states.
tasks.targetState: Every operator session is Identity-owned, permission-bearing, revocable and canonically read back; no browser-selected scope becomes trusted.
tasks.action: Repair the earliest Identity/BFF/session defect, migrate consumers, delete obsolete session fallbacks and add negative/replay tests.
mustNotChange: Do not log raw tokens or credentials.
Do not accept trusted context from client headers/query/body.
Do not rewrite governed historical migrations to make a database pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Refresh rotation and logout/deactivation revocation are atomic and durable.
Control Panel and directly affected surfaces remain contract-compatible with Identity.
tasks.rollback: Roll forward at Identity when persistence/session evidence already changed; never restore a known revocation or migration-governance defect.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Identity/session commit including migration amendment only when a forward governed change is actually required.

tasks.objective: Close Administration roles, permissions, approvals and audit
tasks.currentProblem: Administration can become a broad-role bypass or duplicate Identity truth if projection/workflow state is not distinguished from sovereign actor/permission ownership.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace actors/roles/permissions/approvals/audit/rollback queues to Identity and DSH owners; enforce exact permission plus object/trusted scope, maker-checker where Product Truth requires it, append-only redacted audit and canonical readback.
tasks.targetState: Administration orchestrates governed changes without owning foreign truth; protected actions cannot self-approve, bypass scope or expose secrets/PII.
tasks.action: Correct owner boundaries and server authorization, migrate UI readbacks to canonical responses, remove duplicate role/policy calculations and prove forbidden/cross-scope paths.
mustNotChange: Do not replace exact permission checks with broad role checks.
Do not expose credential/PII values in audit.
Do not self-grant protected approval evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Actor/role/permission truth is read from Identity or approved projection only.
Maker-checker and expected-version rules apply where required.
Audit is durable, redacted and attributable, and delegated owner changes read back canonically.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation-only changes if safe; for persisted governed transitions, roll forward using canonical audit/rollback mechanisms.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused Administration owner/authorization commit after Identity foundation is correct.
